title: Kimbila (1st)

  • Ekakanipāta The Book of the Ones
  • Dvādasamavagga Chapter Twelve

Kimilattheragāthā Kimbila (1st)

“Abhisattova nipatati, Old age falls like a curse; Vayo rūpaṁ aññamiva tatheva santaṁ; it’s the same body, but it seems like someone else’s. Tasseva sato avippavasato, I remember myself as if I were someone else, Aññasseva sarāmi attānan”ti. but I’m still the same, I haven’t been away.

… Kimilo thero ….
